_note: Name dossier knobs (generic_utils.name_dossier; the deep-dive agent's data): which pack suites join per name, which store fields form the progression, the analog features and horizons, the evidence sign rules and the research query templates. No cutoffs on the names: every requested id gets a dossier. Sign rules give a measured direction per item (an arrow), counted per horizon, never summed into a score.

analogs._note: Nearest name-days on the US floor to the name's newest store row: each feature ranked within its day (0-1), Euclidean distance over the ranks, k nearest other names (and k_ind inside its industry) whose labels exist; forward raw returns and excess over that day's median floor name, as quantiles. n_dates = distinct days among the analogs (clustered analogs = weak evidence).

evidence._note: One measured direction per item: up when the rule's up condition holds, down when the down condition holds, else flat. Counted per horizon class (short = 1-2 weeks, mid = 1-3 months, long = 6-12+ months). A count, never a score; the agent classes each horizon from the counts and the outside read.

rules.item: print bar (beat paid in this cell)
cycle: EPS drop the price already pays for

research._note: Query templates for the agent's outside read ({company}, {ticker}, {symbol}, {industry}, {year}, {next_earn}). The agent runs them (WebSearch) after reading the dossier and tags every finding OUTSIDE with its source.
per_name: {company} investor day OR capital markets day OR product launch {year}
{company} regulatory OR litigation OR tariff risk
question: {question}
{question} market impact analysis
{question} timeline date

ledger: Analog median forward return (%, raw) over 7 / 14 / 28 / 56 calendar days: the k nearest US $2B+ name-days to the name's newest store row (each feature ranked within its day; distance over the ranks), other names only, labels known.
Analog median forward excess (pp): each analog's forward return less that day's median floor name. Removes the market's move on the analog days.
Analog 10th / 90th percentile forward return (%): the bad and good cases among the nearest name-days.
Distinct days among the analogs. Few days = the analogs share one market episode: weak evidence.
Close x (1 + analog quantile): the price the analogs' 10th / 50th / 90th percentile path ends at for that horizon.
